arms.CH: S1, search on train 120, fixed dictionary on held-out 30
arms.DH: S2, search on train 120, fixed dictionary on held-out 30

designed_forms: let c=new Array(26).fill(0);for(let x of a){c[x.charCodeAt(0)-97]++;}
goal: v2:2b joint source and dictionary optimization (M1 allows offline source rewriting); compression-first literal policy
metrics: Per arm and width, on all 150: total selections, median, p95, worst, single-character selection fraction, source bytes per selection, dictionary and package bytes, problems choosing a style source, per-problem counts. Held-out arms also report train 120 and held-out 30. Every packet is decoded independently through the canonical codec to a qualified source hash.
not_claimed: M1 is not measured here (150 is not the frozen 500). No autonomous assembly, unseen solving or BITS promotion follows; a BITS candidate would need BITS_PROMOTION.md on its own cohort slot.
pool: S1: the 998 of 1,006 scale150 alternatives that pass the corpus cases with strict parity (8 legacy-shared variants of 169 and 961 fail and are excluded everywhere). S0: each problem's original. S2: S1 plus each qualified rewrite. SE: the rewrite where qualified, else the original.
population: The first 150 development problems (scale150-v1 IDs), exposed development data, corpus cases from admission500-v1 population.py.

predictions.P1: At 256 entries, D uses at least 10% fewer selections than C.
predictions.P2: At 256 entries, D's single-character selection fraction is at least 10 points below C's.
predictions.P3: At 256 entries, E uses no more selections than C (style alone beats the whole existing pool).
predictions.P4: At 128 entries, D uses fewer selections than C.
predictions.P5: On the held-out 30 at 256 entries, DH uses at least 10% fewer selections than CH.

rewrites.count: one per problem, by rewriter agents following STYLE.md
rewrites.failure: a rewrite that fails qualification is recorded and not replaced; that problem has no style source
rewrites.inputs: original, the best existing compact variant and the statement; no dictionary, encoding or measurement output
rewrites.qualification: all corpus cases: unchanged return oracle plus strict parity with the original observation (result, type, arguments after, alias edges)

search.method: matched80-v3 local_search with hybrid_proposer (3/4 joint-v1 span order, 1/4 designed forms)
search.starts: C, D, E from the scale150-refine token-input dictionaries (D0, fitted on all 150). CH, DH from the fallback alphabet with greedy refill on the 120 training problems, so the held-out 30 are never seen.

split.rule: sha256(seed + id) ascending; first 30 held out
